remarks: Turn-key 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath rental with all utilities and grounds care included in rent! Enjoy hassle-free living in this beautiful Newfield colonial on 1.1 acres of gorgeous, park-like property with a large flagstone patio, perfect for al fresco dining and entertaining. Inside you will find a spacious living room with a welcoming fireplace that flows to a formal dining room, updated gourmet kitchen and bright, airy sitting room that can be used for relaxation or as an office. Upstairs you will find a large primary suite with walk-in closet, two well-proportioned bedrooms, and an updated full bath. The lower level offers a large family room with stone fireplace and a second recreational room, with an attached wine closet and separate laundry room. Two-car garage. Ready for immediate occupancy!
